segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Security is critical. Let's discuss threat model and compliance requirements.

segments.speaker: SEC
segments.text: We need to encrypt all sensitive data at rest and in transit. API keys must never be hardcoded.

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: Agreed. We'll use environment variables for secrets. I'll implement TLS for all endpoints.

segments.speaker: SEC
segments.text: Good. Also, all user inputs must be validated. No SQL injection or XSS vulnerabilities.

segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Dev, please implement input validation using Pydantic. When can you have security testing done?

segments.speaker: DEV
segments.text: I'll run OWASP Top 10 checks by September 1st. I'll also setup Secret Manager for credentials.

segments.speaker: SEC
segments.text: Excellent. Let's also implement rate limiting to prevent abuse.

segments.speaker: PM
segments.text: Rate limiting is critical. Dev, implement this by next week. Security clearance needed before launch.
